name: Key store CBOR payloads
description: Test vectors for /keys CoAP resource CBOR encoding (spec 17.5.5). CBOR payloads use string keys for readability. Trust levels: tofu, verified, revoked. IID format is hex colon-separated.

list_keys_response.name: empty_keystore
list_keys_response.description: GET /keys with no stored keys returns empty array

list_keys_response.name: multiple_keys
list_keys_response.description: GET /keys with multiple keys of different trust levels

get_key_response.name: tofu_key
get_key_response.description: GET /keys/{iid} returns full key details for TOFU key

get_key_response.name: verified_key
get_key_response.description: GET /keys/{iid} returns full key details for verified key

get_key_response.name: key_not_found
get_key_response.description: GET /keys/{iid} for unknown IID returns 4.04 Not Found

put_key_request.name: add_tofu_key
put_key_request.description: PUT /keys/{iid} to add new key with TOFU trust

put_key_request.name: update_to_verified
put_key_request.description: PUT /keys/{iid} to upgrade existing key to verified trust

put_key_request.name: revoke_key
put_key_request.description: PUT /keys/{iid} to mark key as revoked

iid_format.name: valid_iid_uppercase
iid_format.description: IID with uppercase hex digits (normalized to lowercase)

iid_format.name: valid_iid_leading_zeros
iid_format.description: IID groups may have leading zeros

iid_format.name: invalid_iid_wrong_groups
iid_format.description: IID must have exactly 4 groups of 4 hex digits

iid_format.name: invalid_iid_non_hex
iid_format.description: IID must contain only hex digits and colons

trust_levels.name: trust_tofu
trust_levels.description: TOFU: Trust On First Use, initial state for discovered keys

trust_levels.name: trust_revoked
trust_levels.description: Revoked: Key compromised or no longer trusted

cbor_encoding.name: pubkey_32bytes
cbor_encoding.description: Ed25519 public key is 32 bytes, encoded as hex string in CBOR

cbor_encoding.name: timestamp_iso8601
cbor_encoding.description: Timestamps use ISO 8601 format with Z suffix (UTC)

cbor_encoding.name: fingerprint_sha256
cbor_encoding.description: Key fingerprint uses SHA256: prefix followed by hex hash
